concepts.title: Regular Languages
concepts.description: Formal languages recognized by finite automata; foundation for lexical analysis.

concepts.title: Lexical Analysis
concepts.description: Tokenizes source text into a token stream using regular patterns.

concepts.title: Context-Free Grammars
concepts.description: Grammars that describe nested syntactic structure used by parsers.

concepts.title: Parsing
concepts.description: Converts a token stream into a structured parse tree or AST.

concepts.title: Abstract Syntax Trees
concepts.description: Tree representation of program structure after parsing.

concepts.title: Semantic Analysis
concepts.description: Checks meaning constraints such as types and scopes on the AST.

concepts.title: Intermediate Representation
concepts.description: Compiler-internal program form between front end and back end.

concepts.title: Code Generation
concepts.description: Emits target machine or bytecode from IR or AST.

concepts.title: Optimization
concepts.description: Transforms IR to improve performance while preserving semantics.

concepts.title: Compilers
concepts.description: End-to-end systems that translate source programs into executable form.
